description: Shake table testing program of 6-story mass timber and hybrid resilient structures (NHERI Converging Design project) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andre Barbosa, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). The Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure (NHERI) Converging Design project is a collaborative effort between multiple universities and industry entities with the goal of creating a new design paradigm in structural engineering that employs multi-objective optimization to maximize functional recovery while integrating sustainability principles in the design process. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: shake table, mass timber, Full-scale, resilient, steel moment frame, steel concentric braced frame. Published 2025-01-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
